name: smart-compact
description: Checkpoint a Claude Code session before compacting, compact it automatically, and rehydrate on your terms with a measured estimate of what comes back.

suggestAt.title: Suggest saving at (tokens)
suggestAt.description: Context size, in tokens, at which Claude offers /smart-compact:save once, in its next reply. It never fires later than 60% of the point where Claude Code compacts on its own. 0 means that 60% point; -1 turns the suggestion off. Ignored when suggestFrom and suggestTo are set.

suggestFrom.title: Suggest saving from (tokens)
suggestFrom.description: With suggestTo, a band instead of a single point: inside it, Claude offers /smart-compact:save at the first turn end after a commit, merge, deploy or state-file write, else at the band's top, so the point varies with each session's work. Kept below where Claude Code compacts on its own. 0: no band.

suggestTo.title: Suggest saving by (tokens)
suggestTo.description: The band's top: the latest point Claude offers /smart-compact:save. 0: no band.

summaryContract.title: Summary contract on every compaction
summaryContract.description: Add the summary contract (standing rules, open decisions, counters, and the latest checkpoint's pointer) to every compaction, automatic ones included. The contract comes from the 'Summary contract' section of ~/.claude/smart-compact/profile.md when present.

checkpointOnCompact.title: Checkpoint at Claude Code's own compactions
checkpointOnCompact.description: When Claude Code compacts on its own (at its threshold, precomputed in the background, or a bare /compact), write a checkpoint for it: a fork of this session writes it with the save skill's rules, alongside the summary. Costs one cached request per compaction. Off: only /smart-compact:save writes checkpoints.

autoRehydrate.title: Rehydrate automatically
autoRehydrate.description: off: you send /smart-compact:rehydrate when you want it (default). after-save: the plugin runs it as soon as a /smart-compact:save compaction finishes. always: also after Claude Code's own compactions, once their checkpoint is written (that one lands after the turn in progress).
